1.title: Supreme Court temporarily unfreezes Trump ballroom construction
1.summary: The temporary order will allow the $400m (£297m) project to continue while the high court mulls a final decision on the case.

2.title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
2.summary: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

3.title: Small Plane Crashes in Western Alaska, Killing Eight
3.summary: The Cessna aircraft was carrying two pilots, two U.S. Army engineers and four contractors to Cape Newenham from Anchorage when it crashed near a U.S. military site, investigators said.

4.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
4.summary: Officials say another three people were injured, and an 18-year-old male suspect shot and arrested.

5.title: Russian double-tap drone strike kills 15 in Ukrainian mall, officials say
5.summary: At least 130 people, including 23 children, were also injured when the shopping centre was hit, according to the regional head.

6.title: Palestinian Teenager Killed After Israeli Settlers Enter West Bank Village
6.summary: Palestinian and Israeli authorities offered divergent accounts of the incident, which came as settler violence has surged across the Israeli-occupied territory.
